notes.title: Notes:
items: The contract is sold as a PROJECT: price comes from scope (people × cycles + matrices + onboarding). Installments split that value — they do not multiply it.
A cycle is one complete run of the chosen journey. Two cycles deliver twice as much and cost twice as much, so they are worth twice as much.
The full people base enters AI and messaging cost: the budget always assumes 100% adoption.
A new matrix uses more hours; every remaining role is automatically calculated as an adapted matrix.
A site is a school or branch. It drives onboarding and PPP, not the matrix price — the same matrix serves all of them.
Voting runs the full AI flow. A workshop skips IA1+IA2 and consumes consulting hours based on the number of workshops contracted.
Full cost = AI (at the chosen preset) + people hours + WhatsApp messages + shared infrastructure. Margin is measured against it.
A UTILITY message starts at R$ 0.035. If Meta reclassifies it as MARKETING, use the 6× safety scenario.
The discount ceiling comes from the target margin. Past it, the quote needs approval before it becomes a proposal.
Exposure is cash received minus cost delivered, installment by installment. The budget calculates two installments per contracted cycle.
The price table is editable on this screen and is not recorded. Check the values before closing a proposal.
